about: Capture-time similarity fixture (#9). `notes` are the existing notes; each capture is typed as one line, as the quick-capture overlay files it. `duplicateOf` names the note the capture repeats (it should be surfaced); `sameTopic` names notes on its subject that it does not repeat (they should not be). Captures with neither are unrelated to every note.

notes.title: Garden shed budget
notes.body: Shed budget so far: foundation blocks 340 euros, cedar cladding 1,150 euros, roofing felt and battens 410 euros, door and window 520 euros. Total committed 2,420 euros, leaving 780 euros of the 3,200 ceiling for fixings, paint and surprises.

notes.title: Shed materials decision
notes.body: Decided on western red cedar cladding instead of pressure-treated pine. Cedar costs about 300 euros more but needs no preservative and weathers to silver. Pine was rejected because the treated boards from the yard were warped.

notes.title: Shed permit check
notes.body: Called the council planning office. A shed under 15 square metres and under 2.5 m tall needs no permit if it sits at least 1 m from the boundary. Ours is 7.2 square metres and 2.3 m tall, 1.5 m from the fence, so no permit is needed.

notes.title: Sourdough hydration notes
notes.body: After a month of bakes, 75% hydration gives the best open crumb with my flour. Lower hydration made tight, dense loaves. At the mountain cabin the dough spread flat, so I drop to 68% there.

notes.title: Sourdough starter feeding
notes.body: Starter routine: feed 1:1:1 by weight (starter, flour, water) every 12 hours and keep it near 24 degrees. It peaks about 6 hours after feeding; use it for dough at the peak.

notes.title: Cold brew coffee guide
notes.body: Cold brew basics: coarse grind, 1 part coffee to 8 parts water by weight, steep in the fridge 16 to 18 hours, filter twice, then dilute the concentrate 1:1 before drinking.

notes.title: Espresso dialing in
notes.body: Espresso with the new beans: 18 g of coffee in, 36 g out, in about 28 seconds. Grind finer if it runs fast and sour, coarser if it runs slow and bitter.

notes.title: Running plan October
notes.body: Three runs a week in October: an easy 5 km on Tuesday, intervals on Thursday (6 x 400 m), and a long run on Sunday building from 10 to 14 km.

notes.title: Knee pain after long runs
notes.body: Pain on the outside of the right knee starts around 10 km into long runs. Probably the IT band. Foam rolling the outer thigh and adding hip strength work twice a week helps.

notes.title: Book notes: Atomic Habits
notes.body: Habit stacking: attach a new habit to one you already do. Design the environment so good habits are the easy default. Aim to get 1% better each day; identity follows repeated small actions.

notes.title: Book notes: Deep Work
notes.body: Attention residue makes switching tasks costly. Schedule deep work in fixed blocks, batch shallow tasks, and plan every minute of the day so distraction has nowhere to go.

notes.title: Lisbon trip planning
notes.body: Lisbon trip: flights on 14 November, a hotel in Alfama for four nights. Ride tram 28, see the Belém tower, and get pastel de nata at Manteigaria.

notes.title: Tax documents checklist
notes.body: For this year's tax return: salary certificates, bank interest statements, receipts for donations, and the health insurance summary. Deadline is 30 April.
